title: Downtown Committee Opens Applications for Cultural Festivals Fund
summary: The City of Syracuse Downtown Committee is opening applications for the Cultural Festivals Fund, offering up to $180,000 in grants ($3,000-$10,000 per festival) to support free, public cultural events held between October 2026 and September 2027. The fund aims to celebrate Syracuse's cultural diversity and activate public spaces, with the first application deadline on August 20, 2026, administered by the Downtown Syracuse Foundation.
